fees.source: https://moosominregionalpark.com/park.html ('15 Amp & Water Daily $30.00' ... '30 Amp & Water Daily $42.00' ... '30 Amp, Water & Sewer Daily $47.00' ... '50 Amp, Water & Sewer Daily $58.00'; 'Park Entry: $11.00 per day, $25.00 for 3 days or $60.00 for season'), read 2026-11-18

note: Regional park on the west shore of Moosomin Lake in the Pipestone Valley, 14 km southwest of Moosomin (Hwy 8, Grid 709, then Lake Road); cabin lots line much of the shore, with a sand beach, boardwalk, marina, boat launches and a store-restaurant. Some serviced sites go to seasonal campers; long stays get the first booking days. --Claude

Nightly share of serviced sites about half; Google 4.4 (169). Lakeview kept (no site within ~50 m over open ground). Pin fine.
